correctness.rationale: Every image is an exact union of the first three/four partition cells, so the Perron-Frobenius action on step densities is exact. The mass-preserving 2x2 matrix has characteristic polynomial (t-1)(t+q), giving the precise n-step transient. A positive fixed step density normalizes to 1. Uniform expansion and a primitive four-state graph imply ergodicity/unique ACIM; branch cylinders establish entropy log lambda. The KL identity and equality iff P=Q follow by exact finite-state stationarity. Exact rational checker verifies 1,001 TV cases; finite tests are explicitly not used as proof.

value.rationale: The motivating source determines symbolic complexity yet leaves quantitative physical statistics unspecified. This theorem resolves an identifiable structural gap: arbitrary continuum of physical step-density relaxation moduli on a single symbolic-entropy plateau, with an exact physical-measure density, every-time evolution and a sharp metric-entropy equality locus. This separates distinguishable statistical dynamical behavior from identical itinerary growth and provides useful explicit benchmarks for transfer operators. The scope is all admissible cut positions and not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice.
